quarterly_data.quarter: Sanken Electric annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (April 2025 - March 2026): consolidated net sales JPY 80,175 million, down JPY 41,444 million (34.1%), mainly because Allegro MicroSystems became an equity-method affiliate in August 2024 and left consolidation. Management states that in Sanken Core's main automotive market battery-EV growth slowed but demand for internal-combustion vehicles including hybrids stayed stable, while in white goods China's shift to domestically made semiconductors cut the company's share and sales fell sharply from the second quarter. Operating loss JPY 4,728 million (prior year loss JPY 3,788 million) as metal price increases and lower China sales outweighed fixed-cost cuts and the back-end production reorganization; ordinary loss JPY 8,839 million; net loss attributable to owners of the parent JPY 9,798 million (prior year net income JPY 50,934 million). Cost-of-sales ratio 90.6%, 11.2 points worse.
quarterly_data.figure: net sales JPY 80,175 million (-34.1%); operating loss JPY 4,728 million; net loss JPY 9,798 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanken Electric annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management changed the targets for FY2028 (the year ending March 2028), the final year of the 2024 mid-term plan, to consolidated net sales of JPY 87.5 billion and a consolidated operating margin of 4% or more, responding to the EV chasm, China's shift to domestic semiconductors and higher metal prices (the MD&A section lists the plan's targets as Sanken Core net sales of JPY 100 billion or more and a 10% operating margin; FY2026 Sanken Core net sales were JPY 78.6 billion with an operating margin of -5.7%). For FY2027 the company expects a loss in the first half as production adjustments continue, and plans to recover in the second half through fixed-cost cuts at Ishikawa Sanken, value added from recovering production and productivity gains as the back-end production reorganization is completed.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2028 target: net sales JPY 87.5 billion, operating margin 4%+; FY2026 Sanken Core JPY 78.6 billion, -5.7%

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanken Electric annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management states that the top line rests on the automotive and white-goods markets: in automotive it will capture continued demand for engine vehicles including hybrids and expand sales of power modules for automotive air conditioning; in white goods it will propose switching customers to new products, expand share at Korean customers, hold share in China and win new customers starting with India. An Asia Strategy Office set up on January 1, 2026 is to expand sales in industrial areas such as data centers, where demand is rising, and a Mobility Strategy Office targets automotive and industrial mass-production programs by joining customers at the advanced-development stage. In FY2026 the company worked to expand sales of products for commercial air conditioning and AI data centers in the industrial market. Cost actions include switching material from gold to copper and seeking appropriate prices for existing gold-based products.

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanken Electric annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: GaN: the company acquired Powdec on April 1, 2025 (merged into the company on October 1, 2025) to bring high-performance GaN power devices to market early; it is combining GaN-on-Si technology from a NEDO program with Powdec's PSJ technology into a proprietary device structure for an early market launch, and is studying vertical GaN-on-GaN devices in a GaN consortium centred on Nagoya University. FY2026 PSJ GaN prototypes gave data suggesting advantages in breakdown voltage and current collapse over conventional GaN HEMTs, and in cascode switching outperformed SJ MOSFETs; productization as an integrated device combined with a MOSFET or control IC is under study. SiC: a NEDO program on SiC smart power IC technology with AIST completed development verification, and the company is studying commercialization of an ultra-low-loss SiC module based on it.

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanken Electric annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 R&D expenses JPY 5,400 million (6.74% of net sales). Products developed in the year: the MD6605 power-electronics control microcontroller (RISC-V CPU core, 22nm ultra-low-leak process, ReRAM); the 100V three-phase MOSFET module SAM4L10M30Z1 for electric compressors in 48V mild-hybrid vehicles; a 1200V IPM-series power device and SAM2 product for automotive electric water-pump drivers; a new SiC MOSFET drive method; the STR5M400 non-isolated converter power IC for small appliances; the STR5A300 non-isolated flyback power IC for white goods and smart meters; an infrared chip LED with reduced back-side light leakage; and an RGB-LED for vehicle interior indirect lighting.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D JPY 5,400 million (6.74% of net sales)
